title: Committed artifact primitives
responsibility: Decode committed JSON, calculate hashes and reject invalid artifact names.

inputs.name: hubContractHash.value
inputs.description: JSON-compatible contract value to serialize consistently before hashing.

inputs.name: hubFile.value
inputs.description: Artifact filename of 1 to 200 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting alphanumeric and containing no double dot.

outputs.name: hubJson
outputs.description: Parsed JSON; malformed text or encoding throws artifact-corrupt.

outputs.name: hubFail
outputs.description: Never returns; throws a generic artifact-unavailable Error with the supplied code.

outputs.name: hubFile
outputs.description: Unchanged accepted filename; invalid names throw invalid-path.
